data.name: ViveTool_PageDescription
data.value: Yatani zinthu za Windows ndi viwango vya kusiyanitsa kudzera ku ViVeTool. Onetsani kapena thetsani zinthu zazikomo za Windows zomwe si zatsopano.

data.name: ViveTool_WarningMessage
data.value: Chiwerengero chachikulu: kusiyanitsa viwango vya Windows kungathe kupanga ku Windows Update, zochita ntchito (apps), madziro, ndipo kukhalika kwa mfundo wa system. Kutsogolani poyambira kuti mupangane 'restore point'. Chonde chifunani ndi Feature IDs zomwe zalinganizidwa kwambiri. Zinthu zina zingafune kuphwitsa komanso zingathe kukhala osiyana kapena kusapeza nthawi yopitiriza popanda backup.

data.name: ViveTool_ViveToolNotFound
data.value: Si viVeTool zikugwirizana. Chonde yadanitsani kapena pangani 'runtime' ya ViVeTool yomwe mukumuthandiza kwambiri.

data.name: ViveTool_ViveToolError
data.value: Zofunika kuangazira mzereka wa ViVeTool zikukhalitsa kukhala ndi zovuta

data.name: ViveTool_SearchPlaceholder
data.value: Yamba nambala ya zinthu kapena dzina kuti utumize...

data.name: ViveTool_PathDescription
data.value: Plugin ili ndi ViVeTool runtime yomwe ikugwirizana nayo m'chigawo choyambalala. Koma mungkhale kusonyeza njira ya custom ViVeTool.exe; ngati njira yokwaniritsa si yopanda, ntchito yomwe yakugwirizana nazo kapena yosinthidwa ndi yomwe pali ndiyo idzikutetsedwa kugwiritsidwa ntchito.
